atoms.text: England is the biggest country in the United Kingdom. The capital city of England is London.
atoms.sound: England is the biggest country in the United Kingdom. The capital city of England is London.

instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Frage.

atoms.text: London is about seven times bigger than any other city in England. London and the surrounding areas are home to about a fifth of the people living in the United Kingdom. The surrounding areas of London's suburbs are also known as “commuter land” because a lot of people who live there travel into London for work every day.

atoms.a: Dover, in the south-east, has a famous ferry port. The ferries are used to transport people but also trading goods. The region around Dover is known as the “Garden of England”. Different kinds of vegetables and fruits grow there.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>ferry</lang> bedeutet Fähre. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>port</lang> bedeutet Hafen. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>trading goods</lang> bedeutet Handelsware.
hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.a: East of London, there are some hills and the area called Surrey is used for sheep farming.
North of London, there's Cambridge. The city is famous for its university and gothic architecture.

instruction.text: Höre zu und wähle das passende Bild zum Text aus.

atoms.a: The south coast is famous for its white cliffs. The seaside towns in the south, such as Brighton, are also a popular holiday destination for the Brits.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>cliff</lang> bedeutet Klippe. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>Brits</lang> ist eine Bezeichnung für die Menschen aus dem Vereinigten Königreich. Es ist die Kurzform für <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>British people</lang>.
hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.a: In the south-west, there's an area called Dartmoor. It's a national park. There are many hills, tors and some rivers. Because it sometimes rains heavily in the moorlands, bogs can appear.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>moor</lang> bedeutet Moor oder Heidelandschaft. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>tor</lang> bedeutet Felsformation. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>bog</lang> bedeutet Sumpf.
hint.label: Vocabulary

atoms.a: Bristol is a university city in the south-west of England. It's famous for the “Clifton Suspension Bridge” as well as the “SS Great Britain”, the first iron steam ship that crossed the Atlantic Ocean.

hint.text:
suspension bridge – Hängebrücke
iron steam ship – eisernes Dampfschiff

atoms.text: The Midlands are mainly known for their industrial past. During the Industrial Revolution, Birmingham and the surrounding areas became the centre of engineering. It is the also second largest city in the United Kingdom. The surrounding area is sometimes referred to as the “Black Country”. The title is a reference to the black smoke that came from industry.

hint.text: Fun fact: Birmingham is one of the partner cities of Frankfurt, Germany. Every year, the “Frankfurt Christmas Market” takes place in Birmingham. It's the biggest German Christmas market outside of Germany.
